meta.name: xlsx
meta.description: Use this skill any time a spreadsheet file is the primary input or output. This means any task where the user wants to: open, read, edit, or fix an existing .xlsx, .xlsm, .csv, or .tsv file (e.g., adding columns, computing formulas, formatting, charting, cleaning messy data); create a new spreadsheet from scratch or from other data sources; or convert between tabular file formats. Trigger especially when the user references a spreadsheet file by name or path — even casually (like "the xlsx in my downloads") — and wants something done to it or produced from it. Also trigger for cleaning or restructuring messy tabular data files (malformed rows, misplaced headers, junk data) into proper spreadsheets. The deliverable must be a spreadsheet file. Do NOT trigger when the primary deliverable is a Word document, HTML report, standalone Python script, database pipeline, or Google Sheets API integration, even if tabular data is involved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Process spreadsheet files including reading, editing, formatting, and converting
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently work with Excel or CSV files

howto.what: Claude 可以打开、编辑、创建和修复 .xlsx、.csv 等表格文件，添加公式、格式化、制图、清理数据，并输出表格文件。
howto.when: 当你提到一个表格文件（如 .xlsx、.csv）的名称或路径，并要求对其进行操作（如读取、编辑、创建、转换格式）时触发。

say.text: 帮我打开 downloads 里的销售数据.xlsx，计算总销售额。
say.note: Claude 会读取文件并添加 SUM 公式。

say.text: 把这个 CSV 文件转成格式化的 Excel，并添加图表。
say.note: Claude 会创建新 .xlsx 文件并生成图表。

say.text: 修复这个表格里的 #REF! 错误。
say.note: Claude 会检查并修正公式错误。

howto.what_en: Claude can open, edit, create, and fix .xlsx, .csv, and other spreadsheet files, adding formulas, formatting, charts, cleaning data, and outputting a spreadsheet file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention a spreadsheet file name or path (e.g., .xlsx, .csv) and request an action like reading, editing, creating, or converting formats.

say_en.text: Open the sales data.xlsx in my downloads and calculate total sales.
say_en.note: Claude will read the file and add a SUM formula.

say_en.text: Convert this CSV file into a formatted Excel with a chart.
say_en.note: Claude will create a new .xlsx file and generate a chart.

say_en.text: Fix the #REF! errors in this spreadsheet.
say_en.note: Claude will check and correct formula errors.
